posts.title: Three Days in Boyd Station
posts.excerpt: A small Kentucky community reveals itself through wildflower meadows, a vintage truck restoration, and a late-night set at the Aeolian Music Hall.
posts.leadImageAlt: Musicians perform at the Aeolian Music Hall in Boyd Station, Ky., beneath a glowing red neon sign, June 12, 2025.
